data_card.measured: Water-surface elevations and velocities around a 90° open-channel junction in a laboratory flume, for several discharge ratios (Weber et al. 2001).
data_card.method: Laboratory point gauges and velocity probes, as described in the paper; the data are to be obtained from the authors.
data_card.uncertainty: Not yet stated: the value in reference.uncertainty is a placeholder until the published gauge or survey error is recorded.
known_issues: Journal-only data: no open licence found yet.
data_card.exercises: Combining flow at a junction: the depth rise upstream of the junction, the separation zone and the contraction in the combined branch.
data_card.cannot_tell: A 1D model can match the upstream depths while missing the separation zone entirely; a match on depths says nothing about velocities across the channel.
